part.text:
Fixed XINFO GROUPS lag handling in `src/t_stream.c`:

- Detect tombstones between the group’s `last_id` and stream end, even when the latest tombstone precedes the first live entry.
- Invalidate estimated read counters when fragmentation exists after the group’s last-delivered ID (while preserving the zero-ID case).
- Use the group’s previous `last_id` when deciding whether to increment `entries_read`, so a skipped tombstone forces recomputation.
